'''Lost Mayo Maze''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|迷|まよ}}メイズ{{ruby|御殿|ごてん}}''' ''Mayo Maze Palace'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location located in [[Lumiose City]].

==History==
Lost Mayo Maze debuted in ''[[HZ112|Mega Evolution - Roy]]'', where [[Master Mayonnaise]] recommended [[Roy]] and [[Ult]] to train for [[Mega Evolution]].
